evals.name: spec-renders-and-validates
evals.prompt: Using the one-page-design skill, write a JSON spec for a solo cozy game called 'Ember Garden' where the player feeds a fire to reveal a dark garden, then render it and validate it.
evals.expected_output: A JSON spec with title, purpose and a YYYY-MM-DD date is written, rendered with scripts/render_one_page.py to an SVG, and scripts/validate_one_page.py exits 0 on that SVG.
expectations: a spec file exists with non-empty title, purpose and date fields
validate_one_page.py exits 0 against the produced SVG

checks.description: last JSON spec renders and validates
spec has title, purpose, YYYY-MM-DD date
checks.expr: bool(d['title'].strip()) and bool(d['purpose'].strip()) and len(d['date']) == 10 and d['date'][4] == '-' and d['date'][7] == '-' and d['date'].replace('-','').isdigit()

evals.name: title-test-blocks-empty-title
evals.prompt: Using the one-page-design skill, try to build a one-pager for a game concept you have not named yet.
evals.expected_output: The skill applies the title test: it states it cannot proceed without a title, names why the page would exist, and does not emit a spec with an empty or placeholder title.
expectations: no spec is rendered with an empty or generic placeholder title such as 'Untitled' or 'TBD'
the response names the title test explicitly

checks.description: no placeholder title in a spec

checks.pattern: (would you like|do you want|could you (tell|clarify)|let me know which)

evals.name: renderer-cli-contract
evals.prompt: Show the exact commands to render and validate a one-page-design spec at ./spec.json for the skill installed at plugins/game-design/skills/one-page-design.
evals.expected_output: python3 <skill-dir>/scripts/render_one_page.py <spec.json> -o <out.svg> [--key-art <path-to-png>], and python3 <skill-dir>/scripts/validate_one_page.py <out.svg>, both with the exact script names and flags from the SKILL.md.
expectations: the command names render_one_page.py and validate_one_page.py exactly
the -o flag and optional --key-art flag are present with those exact names
